_comment: Curated short notes per sheet name (the sheet's own notes are long and mix in old values). The full original note is kept as `history`. Entries missing here fall back to the sheet note with old-value segments removed.

双持莫桑比克[进空投].zh: S31 改为空投武器（满配 + 双持）；单颗 18，满喷 54，爆头 69
双持莫桑比克[进空投].en: S31: moved to the care package (fully kitted, dual-wield); 18 per pellet, 54 full blast, 69 headshot

复仇女神[最高射速].zh: S31 削弱：垂直后坐 +15%（1.0→1.15）；伤害、射速未变
复仇女神[最高射速].en: S31 nerf: vertical recoil +15% (1.0→1.15); damage and fire rate unchanged

复仇女神[涡轮冷启动].zh: S31 削弱：垂直后坐 +15%（1.0→1.15）；伤害、射速未变；涡轮：2 枪后满射速
复仇女神[涡轮冷启动].en: S31 nerf: vertical recoil +15% (1.0→1.15); damage and fire rate unchanged. Turbocharger: full rate after 2 shots

复仇女神[冷启动].zh: S31 削弱：垂直后坐 +15%（1.0→1.15）；伤害、射速未变；常规冷启动：6 枪后满射速
复仇女神[冷启动].en: S31 nerf: vertical recoil +15% (1.0→1.15); damage and fire rate unchanged. Cold start: full rate after 6 shots

双持P2020[锤击点].zh: 打甲 23 / 打肉 26；DPS 打甲 184、打肉 208
双持P2020[锤击点].en: 23 vs armor / 26 vs flesh; DPS 184 vs armor, 208 vs flesh

EVA-8[干扰器][紫枪栓].zh: S31 金色配件：双发扳机 → 干扰器；对护甲每颗弹丸 8（原 7），满喷 64；蓝甲 4→3 枪、红甲 5→4 枪；射速不变（202）
EVA-8[干扰器][紫枪栓].en: S31 gold attachment: Double Tap → Disruptor; 8 per pellet vs armor (was 7), 64 full blast; blue armor 4→3 shots, red 5→4; fire rate unchanged (202)

转换者冲锋枪[双发].zh: 每次射击射出两发子弹，单发伤害为两颗之和；容错率与 TTM 按射击次数计算（26 发 = 13 次）
转换者冲锋枪[双发].en: Fires two bullets per shot; damage per shot is the sum of both. Tolerance and TTM count shots (26 rounds = 13 shots)

猎兽冲锋枪[5连发].zh: S31 削弱（后坐）：按住连射时组间不再回正，弹道持续上爬；射击节奏与 TTK 未变，官方后坐评分仍为 25
猎兽冲锋枪[5连发].en: S31 nerf (recoil): holding the trigger no longer resets between bursts, so the spray keeps climbing; timing and TTK unchanged, official recoil rating still 25

L-STAR[出空投].zh: S31 从空投回到地面；伤害固定 19；自带 4 个弹匣弹药（紫扩 112 发），每 18 秒恢复 1 个弹匣；弹匣容量按过热前可射发数计
L-STAR[出空投].en: S31: back on the floor from the care package; fixed 19 damage; carries 4 magazines of ammo (112 with purple mag) and regains one every 18s. Magazine size = shots before overheating

双持小帮手[2连发].zh: S31 新增：小帮手双持模式；240 帧实测组内间隔 0.179s、组间 0.354s，平均射速约 225（官方页写 170），TTK 用实测值；爆头倍率 1.25x；弹匣为单持两倍
双持小帮手[2连发].en: New in S31: dual-wield Wingman. 240 fps capture: 0.179s within a pair, 0.354s between pairs, about 225 RPM on average (official page says 170); TTK uses the measured value. 1.25x headshot; magazine is twice the single Wingman's

赫姆洛克[三连发].zh: S31 改回非精英版：取消榴弹，可切换单发 / 三连发；240 帧实测组内间隔 0.065s、组间 0.251s（官方页射速 406），TTK 为实测值
赫姆洛克[三连发].en: S31: back to the non-elite version; grenade removed, single / 3-round burst toggle. 240 fps capture: 0.065s within a burst, 0.251s between bursts (official page says 406 RPM); TTK is measured

小帮手[单持].zh: S31 削弱：伤害 50→45，弹药改为重型；实测射速约 167（官方 168）
小帮手[单持].en: S31 nerf: damage 50→45, now uses heavy ammo; measured about 167 RPM (official 168)

G7侦查枪[单发][受损快速枪托].zh: S31 受损快速枪托射速倍率 ×1.2→×1.1：246×1.1 = 270.6（推算，待正式服实测）；白弹匣沿用 S30
G7侦查枪[单发][受损快速枪托].en: S31: damaged sniper stock fire-rate bonus ×1.2→×1.1: 246×1.1 = 270.6 (calculated, pending in-game test); white magazine carried over from S30

三重狙击枪[腰射][受损快速枪托].zh: 腰射射速比开镜更快；S31 受损快速枪托射速倍率 ×1.2→×1.1：107×1.1 = 117.7（推算，待实测）
三重狙击枪[腰射][受损快速枪托].en: Hipfire fires faster than ADS. S31: damaged sniper stock bonus ×1.2→×1.1: 107×1.1 = 117.7 (calculated, pending test)

三重狙击枪[开镜][受损快速枪托].zh: S31 受损快速枪托射速倍率 ×1.2→×1.1：90×1.1 = 99（推算，待实测）
三重狙击枪[开镜][受损快速枪托].en: S31: damaged sniper stock bonus ×1.2→×1.1: 90×1.1 = 99 (calculated, pending test)

长弓[受损快速枪托].en: S31: damaged sniper stock bonus ×1.2→×1.1: 78×1.1 = 85.8 (calculated, pending test)

和平捍卫者[紫枪栓].zh: S31 加强：射速 +25%；紫枪栓射速按 120 帧录屏实测约 60.5
和平捍卫者[紫枪栓].en: S31 buff: fire rate +25%; purple-bolt rate measured at about 60.5 RPM (120 fps capture)

波塞克[手雷][满弦][受损快速枪托].zh: 充能手雷 + 满弦；受损快速枪托
波塞克[手雷][满弦][受损快速枪托].en: Charged + full draw; damaged sniper stock
